title: Court ruling.
bodyText: The court shall rule on a motion under section 634G-3(a) no later than sixty days after the hearing under section 634G-4.
bodyHtml: [§634G-7]  Court ruling.  The court shall rule on a motion under section 634G-3(a) no later than sixty days after the hearing under section 634G-4. [L 2022, c 96, pt of §2]
